title: Replay: Macron, Carney hail new chapter on France-Canada ties at St. Pierre and Miquelon meeting
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron said France and Canada were "two great independent nations who want to stay that way" in a joint news conference with Canadian leader Mark Carney Sunday. Watch the press conference by the two leaders on the French overseas territory of Saint Pierre and Miquelon just off Canada's Atlantic coast.
